test_title: PYST 4: SSC JE EE - Reasoning (Held on: 24 March 2021 (Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All crops are seeds.

2. No seed is a plant.

3. No plant is a flower.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some seeds are crops.

II. No crop is a flower.

III. No crop is a plant.

IV. No flower is a seed.

options.text: Only conclusions I, II and III follow
Only conclusions I, III and IV follow
Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions I and III follow

solution: The least possible Venn diagram is: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4244d0c48a97c49ffacea44b32b8030349d5c5b9c26fbb502150480e7ce792b5.png] Conclusions: I. Some seeds are crops → True (As All crops are seeds, So, some part of seeds are crops) II. No crop is a flower → False (It can be possible, not definite).
